# 831. Masking Personal Information

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maskPII(self, s):
        """
        :type s: str
        :rtype: str
        """
        at = s.find('@')
        if at >= 0:
            return (s[0] + "*" * 5 + s[at - 1:]).lower()
        s = "".join(i for i in s if i.isdigit())
        return ["", "+*-", "+**-", "+***-"][len(s) - 10] + "***-***-" + s[-4:]
```
